say: The model wrote every line, including the shaders, the physics, the rig and the level.
But every fix started with a person saying what was wrong.
The notes were things like: the torso is too slender, the armpit stretches, and that menu covers too much.
That is the job now: taste, direction, and knowing what good looks like.
Game developers are not cooked, but the job has changed shape.
Aero. You can play it at M P T S dot I E, slash games, slash Aero.
